title: The Abnormal reading
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：abnormal　|　正文 328 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 abnormal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the craftsman wrote of ① an abnormal reading in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② more abnormal than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the abnormal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most abnormal reading anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too abnormal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the abnormal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an abnormal winter silence, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as abnormal as the winter silence they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was abnormal or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something abnormal, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite abnormal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the abnormal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, at once, she wrote of another abnormal reading in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more abnormal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most abnormal winter silence in the whole workshop, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the abnormal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 反常（前置定语 an abnormal reading：1964 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件反常的读数）
B. adj. 反常／异常（比较级 more abnormal than：文中两处，一处比读数，一处比预想）
C. adj. 反常／异常（最高级 the most abnormal：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 反常（表语 too abnormal to do：母亲觉得它太反常，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 异常（前置定语 an abnormal winter silence：叔叔把整件事称作一桩异常的寂静）
F. adj. 异常（同级比较 as abnormal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩冬日的寂静相比）
G. adj. 异常（后置定语 something abnormal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 异常（受程度副词修饰 quite abnormal：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: The most abnormal winter silence in

answers.why: abnormal 意为“反常”，1964 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件反常的读数”，此处作前置定语 an abnormal reading。
abnormal 意为“反常”，此处用比较级 more abnormal than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
abnormal 意为“反常”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说它是工坊里最反常的一件，故用最高级 the most abnormal reading。
abnormal 意为“反常”，母亲认为这件东西“太反常了，谁也用不上”，too abnormal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
abnormal 意为“异常”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩异常的寂静”，此处作前置定语 an abnormal winter silence。
abnormal 意为“异常”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩冬日的寂静一样异常”，同级比较用 as abnormal as。
abnormal 意为“异常”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“异常的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something abnormal。
abnormal 意为“异常”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当异常”，quite 修饰原级 abnormal。
abnormal 意为“异常”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要异常”，故用比较级 more abnormal than。
abnormal 意为“异常”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个工坊里最异常的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most abnormal winter silence。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件反常的读数。（an abnormal reading）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更反常。（more abnormal than …）
母亲觉得它太反常，谁也用不上。（too abnormal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩异常的寂静。（an abnormal winter silence）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩冬日的寂静一样异常。（as abnormal as …）
到了 1971 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件异常的东西。（something abnormal）
answers: In 1964 the craftsman wrote of an abnormal reading in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more abnormal than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too abnormal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an abnormal winter silence.
He said nobody would call it as abnormal as the winter silence they had once had.
By 1971 the ledger asked for nothing but something abnormal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 abnormal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the craftsman wrote of an abnormal reading in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most abnormal reading in the workshop, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too abnormal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an abnormal winter silence, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite abnormal, and everybody laughed.
The abnormal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
